summary: The Senior Big Data Engineer leads complex data engineering initiatives, designs high performance data architectures, and mentors junior engineers while ensuring system scalability and reliability.
responsibilities: Design and implement enterprise-scale big data architectures
Optimize performance of data pipelines and storage systems
Lead complex data integration and migration projects
Review code and enforce engineering best practices
Collaborate with stakeholders on data strategy and requirements
Ensure security, compliance, and governance standards

education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field
5–8 years of experience in Big Data Engineering

skills_required.name: Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Deep knowledge of data lakes and data warehouses
